key_insight: GTFormer replaces self-attention with a syntax-free hierarchical graph, reporting 8192× length extrapolation with linear-time computation and linear memory.
engineering_relevance: A bounded-degree graph backbone could make million-token code, log, and retrieval workloads feasible without quadratic attention costs.
method: Build a balanced binary token hierarchy with ⌈log₂ N⌉ depth.
Add horizontal boundary-bridging edges and random expander shortcuts.
Combine multi-channel convex highway gating with top-down broadcasting.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports near-perfect accuracy across eight long-context benchmarks, training only at N ≤ 512 and evaluating zero-shot up to 4,194,304 tokens on one commodity GPU.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify hardware, runtime measurements, or benchmark details needed to assess practical efficiency and reproducibility.
paper_title: GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
